channel.title: News Talk 980 CKNW - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from News Talk 980 CKNW (cknw.com)

item.title: Saskatchewan Polytechnic students feeling ‘blindsided’ as program moves cities
item.description: Students at Saskatchewan Polytechnic say they are feeling frustrated after being told they would have to move to Regina from Saskatoon to finish their diploma program.

item.title: Does ‘toothless’ report exonerate Quebec Liberals? The National Assembly is divided
item.description: A retired judge released a 39-page report into possible wrongdoing during Pablo Rodriguez's Liberal leadership campaign.

item.title: Edson hasn’t received mail in 2 weeks due to Canada Post office flooding
item.description: What was initially expected to be a short-term closure has instead left Canada Post mail operations suspended indefinitely in Edson and Yellowhead County.

item.title: Winnipeg Blue Bombers GM Kyle Walters takes aggressive approach in free agency
item.description: Speaking 48 hours into free agency, Blue Bombers general manager Kyle Walters said standing pat was not an option after their fourth-place finish in the west last season.

item.title: Tumbler Ridge students who survived shooting spree describe terrifying lockdown
item.description: 'We're wondering who's hunting close to town and a few minutes later, you hear all the alarms going off,' Grade 12 student Zachary Taylor told Global News.

item.title: Adaptive bikes stolen from Kelowna non-profit, leaving disability community reeling
item.description: 'What am I going to do? What are the people in the disabled community going to do? How is it going to affect them?' Kent Stewart asked.

item.title: Okanagan mourns lives lost in Tumbler Ridge ahead of candlelight vigils
item.description: Canadian flags are flying at half-mast across the Okanagan in the wake of the shooting tragedy in Tumbler Ridge, B.C.

item.title: Father of Tumbler Ridge school shooter issues statement: ‘I carry a sorrow’
item.description: BC RCMP confirmed that multiple police visits had been made to the 18-year-old Jesse VanRootselaar's home due to concerns of mental health and self-harm.

item.title: ‘We now have to figure out how to live life without her’: Mother of Tumbler Ridge shooting victim speaks
item.description: Sarah Lampert spoke to reporters Thursday night about her daughter, Ticaria, who was among eight people killed in the attack that also left the shooter dead and dozens injured.

item.title: Alberta Sheriffs continue to remove unsafe commercial vehicles from roadways
item.description: Alberta Sheriffs continue to work to remove unsafe commercial vehicles from Alberta roadways. Over the course of 2025 more than 15,000 inspections were conducted.
